question: For the two preserved canonical actual-purchase rounds (1247 and 1248), how many winning numbers were reachable by the six frozen reference candidate rankers at K=10/15/20/25/30, how many were in the actual purchased ticket union, and how much additional loss arose from ticket allocation within that union?

excluded_sources.1246: EXCLUDED_UNRESOLVED: two distinct pre-draw five-line sets exist and no receipt resolves which was actually purchased.
excluded_sources.1245: The preserved ERROR_NOTE_1245_AGGREGATE contains V4 recommendations without verified purchase receipts; not treated as actual purchase.

method.training_cutoff_rule: For target t, ranker features use only draws 1..t-1. The target draw is read only after ranks are frozen.
method.ranker_formula: Exact formulas, population z-scores, ascending-number tie-break, and windows from automation/candidate_recall_v1.py; no modifications.
method.stage_interpretation: Reference-ranker reach is descriptive and is not the actual selector's candidate bank. A winner outside every reference top30 is labelled reference-ranker-unreached, not proven causally excluded by the actual selector. A winner in the actual ticket union but not concentrated in the best line is an observed allocation gap.

limitations: Only two canonical actual-purchase targets are currently verifiable; no population-level inference or confidence interval is authorized.
1244-1248 are previously exposed live-history diagnostics, not clean holdouts.
No model, weight, threshold, allocator, or purchase policy is selected or changed.
No future outcome after round 1249 is used.
No candidate or purchase lines are generated.
promotion_rule: Diagnostic only. No model promotion, strict PASS, predictive superiority claim, or change to the target-1251 three-line policy is permitted.
